تفترضن (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِضْنَ (taftariḍna) /taf.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# تُفْتَرَضْنَ (tuftaraḍna) /tuf.ta.radˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
